composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-117, "GAS/CO/P.VAPOUR ALARM") serves the Gas/CO/Petrol Vapour Alarm system (696-gas-alarms), plus related equipment fed off the AFT DC Panel: Fire Alarm (695-fire-alarm), Engine-room ventilation extractor/fan interlocks (599-ventilation-fans / 599-engroom-blower-extractor), and downstream shutoff devices — the Gas Solenoid Valve and Galley Extractor cut-off — which belong to the gas alarm system's protective action rather than to the galley extraction hood itself. The AFT DC PANEL breakers (Q34, QE3, Q18, Q19, QE4, Q20), the T/S C terminal strips, the Re27-Re34 relay bank, the CONTROL PANEL indicator/alarm bank, the DISPLAY PLC and J/BOX # terminal strip are all infrastructure of the gas/CO/petrol-vapour alarm control loop drawn on this sheet, feeding the ALARM MOD1/MOD2/MOD3 horns and the Hydrogen Fluoride Sensor monitoring loop. Evidence: sheet title itself ("GAS/CO/ P. VAPOUR ALARM"), breaker labels (PETROL VAPOUR ALARM Q19, GAS/CO ALARM Q20, FIRE ALARM Q18), the J/BOX # table naming LPG1-3/CO-1-3/PETROL1-3 channels tied to the DISPLAY PLC, and the GAS SLONOID VALVE / GALLEY output devices driven by Re1-Re3 from the same J/BOX terminal strip.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet title is 'GAS/CO/ P. VAPOUR ALARM'; the PETROL VAPOUR ALARM (Q19) and GAS/CO ALARM (Q20) breakers, the DISPLAY PLC LPG1-3/CO-1-3/PETROL1-3 channel taps, the CONTROL PANEL alarm/mute/emergency-stop lamps, and the Gas Solenoid Valve / Galley extractor cutoff outputs are all part of this one monitoring & shutdown system per engineer mapping 'PETROL VAPOUR ALARM -> 696-gas-alarms' and 'GAS/CO2/PETROL VAPOUR ALARM -> 696-gas-alarms'.

functions.label: Petrol vapour detection and ventilation interlock
functions.what_it_does: Detects a petrol-vapour alarm condition via Q19 (PETROL VAPOUR ALARM 10A) and drives relay Re27, whose contacts feed T/S C terminals 160/161 into the Re29/Re30/Re31 relay group; this group commands the PETROL VAPOUR FAN (via the SIEMENS 3UG4621-1AW30 monitoring relay Re30) and provides the interlocked cut-off signal to the Galley Extractor (220V AC contact shown top-right 'to cut galley Extractor power').
key_components: T/S C 160-169 terminal strip (fused terminal noted at 177 elsewhere)

flow_scenarios.path: Q19 supply -> Re27 (de-energised) -> no signal into T/S C 160/161 -> Re29/Re30 group idle -> Petrol Vapour Fan off; Galley Extractor power not cut

Q19 10A -> Re27 energised -> T/S C 160/161 -> Re29 coil circuit -> Re30 (SIEMENS 3UG4621-1AW30) changeover contact 11/12/14 switches -> feeds Petrol Vapour Fan control and the 220V AC contact that cuts galley extractor power (dotted box top-right) -> also drives Re31/Re32 contacts into T/S C 162-169 -> CONTROL PANEL terminals 1-7 (ALARM MOD1 horn, ALARM MUTE lamp/switch, EMERGENCY STOP (Petrol vapour ventilation) and EMERGENCY STOP (Galley Extractor) indicator lamps)

functions.dry_data: Re30 module: SIEMENS 3UG4621-1AW30 monitoring relay, contact set 11/12/14, I>< symbol (current/thermal monitoring type); Q19 breaker 10A
functions.sheet_region: top-left to top-center, breaker bank + Re27/Re29/Re30/Re31/Re32 relay bank + T/S C 160-169, and CONTROL PANEL terminals 1-7 (0.12-0.78, 0.09-0.5)

functions.label: CO/LPG/Petrol channel monitoring via Display PLC and J/BOX
functions.what_it_does: The DISPLAY PLC (with signal leads B2, A1, C32/C33, D5-D35, B7/B8, B16-B36, C28, A3, B11) taps into the J/BOX # terminal strip (T/S CA terminals 1-41) which carries per-channel wiring for three LPG sensors, three CO sensors, and three PETROL vapour sensors (LPG1-3, CO-1-3, PETROL1-3), duplicated across terminal groups 1-13 and 14-41 for redundant/per-circuit taps.

flow_scenarios.path: Sensor loops for LPG1-3/CO-1-3/PETROL1-3 (off-sheet, at J/BOX #) -> T/S CA terminals 1-13 and 14-41 -> DISPLAY PLC input leads (B2,A1,C32,C33,D5-D35,B7,B17,B18,B26,B27,B36,C28,A3,B11) -> PLC evaluates channel state

PLC drives downstream relay bank Re1/Re2/Re3 (fed from terminal_strip_left near T/S CA terminals 11-13) -> energises GAS SOLONOID VALVE (shut-off) and/or MOD3 ALARM horn and/or GALLEY switch/lamp cutoff

functions.dry_data: T/S CA terminal strip, 41 terminals; channel labels duplicated at terminals 2-13 and 14-40 (LPG1/2/3, CO-1/2/3, PETROL1/2/3)
functions.sheet_region: bottom-left/bottom-center, DISPLAY PLC (0.15-0.32,0.77-0.99) and J/BOX # T/S CA (0.34-0.65,0.78-1.0)

functions.label: Gas solenoid valve shutoff and galley alarm output
functions.what_it_does: Relay bank Re1-Re3 (fed from the J/BOX/T-S CA wiring near terminals 11-13) switches the GAS SLONOID VALVE closed and sounds the MOD3 ALARM horn on a detected gas condition; a GALLEY push-button/lamp is also wired into this same relay group for local mute/indication at the galley.

flow_scenarios.path: Re1/Re2/Re3 de-energised -> Gas Solenoid Valve remains in normal (open) service position -> MOD3 alarm silent

T/S CA terminal(s) 11-13 -> Re1 coil (+ side from terminal strip left column, unfused/fused terminal not clearly marked) -> Re2/Re3 contact chain -> GAS SLONOID VALVE energised to shut; simultaneously -> MOD3 ALARM horn sounds; GALLEY pushbutton/lamp available for local mute/ack (return side to GALLEY switch+lamp)

functions.dry_data: Re1/Re2/Re3 relay identifiers only; part numbers/fuse ratings not legible — capture at inspection if needed
functions.sheet_region: bottom-right, Re1/Re2/Re3 block and GAS SLONOID VALVE / GALLEY outputs (0.5-0.98, 0.85-0.96)

functions.label: Control panel alarm/status annunciation (ALARM MOD1 & MOD2)
functions.what_it_does: A dedicated CONTROL PANEL (dotted enclosure) presents two alarm modules: ALARM MOD1 (horn) with an ALARM MUTE pushbutton/lamp and two EMERGENCY STOP indicator lamps (Petrol vapour ventilation; Galley Extractor), and ALARM MOD2 (horn) with its own ALARM MUTE lamp, a FAN ON-OFF MONITOR indicator, and a NO POWER lamp. These are wired via T/S C terminals 162-177 to the upstream relay contacts (Re31/Re32/Re33/Re34) that reflect the petrol-vapour and fan-monitor loop states.

flow_scenarios.path: No alarm condition -> T/S C 162-177 lines quiescent -> all control panel lamps off, horns silent

Re31/Re32 contact group -> T/S C 162-169 -> CONTROL PANEL terminals 1 (ALARM MOD1 horn), 2 (ALARM MUTE), 3 (lamp), 4 (lamp), 5 (EMERGENCY STOP Petrol vapour ventilation lamp), 6 (lamp), 7 (EMERGENCY STOP Galley Extractor lamp) — feed side traced from relay contacts; positive/+bus feed for the lamps themselves not traced on this sheet (each lamp's + side is only annotated 'control panel bus +', not drawn to a source)

flow_scenarios.state: fan monitor / alarm mod2 path active
flow_scenarios.path: Re33 contact group -> T/S C 170-177 -> CONTROL PANEL terminals 8 (ALARM MOD2 horn), 9 (ALARM MUTE), 10 (lamp), 11 (FAN ON-OFF MONITOR IND.), 12 (lamp), 13 (NO POWER lamp) -> terminal 177 shown with a fused-terminal marker on its incoming line
Contact group above Re34 -> T/S 178-179 -> feeds the ALARM OUT block (dotted enclosure) at far right

functions.label: Hydrogen Fluoride sensor alarm output (battery compartment)
functions.what_it_does: Re34's output at T/S 178-179 (ALARM OUT block) provides a status/alarm connection to a Hydrogen Fluoride Sensor located in the battery compartment; this is drawn as a one-way status tap into the ALARM OUT dotted box — its own positive/feed side back to the sensor is not traced on this sheet.
key_components: Re34 relay (with indicator lamp on coil)

flow_scenarios.path: Hydrogen Fluoride Sensor (battery compartment) -> ALARM OUT terminal block -> (return path only traced; positive/feed side to the sensor not traced on this sheet)

functions.sheet_region: right-center, ALARM OUT / Hydrogen Fluoride Sensor dotted box (0.82-0.92, 0.62-0.7)

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Engine Room / ESS Ventilation Fan interlock (petrol vapour fan + galley extractor cutoff)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The PETROL VAPOUR FAN and the 'to cut galley Extractor power' contact are ventilation devices driven by the gas-alarm loop but are themselves ventilation equipment (per mapping 'FUEL / ENG. VENTILATION -> 599-ventilation-fans', 'SERVICE BAT. VENTILATION -> 599-ventilation-fans'); the AC230V Q34 6A breaker feeding ESS VENTILATION/TENDERGARAGE (cross-ref DWG 102) also belongs to this ventilation node's supply picture, not the alarm system itself.

functions.label: Petrol vapour extraction fan and galley extractor power cutoff
functions.what_it_does: The Petrol Vapour Fan is switched via the Re29/Re30/Re31 relay chain fed from the petrol-vapour-alarm loop (Q19/Re27); a separate 220V AC contact ('to cut galley Extractor power') is provided to interrupt galley extractor power when the same interlock trips.
key_components: 220V AC cut-off contact (unlabeled coil in dotted box)

flow_scenarios.path: Fan off, galley extractor power not interrupted

Interlock relay chain (Re27->Re29->Re30) energises Petrol Vapour Fan (feed side conductor from left edge not fully traced on this sheet) and opens/closes the 220V AC contact to cut galley extractor power (feed side likewise not traced — arrives from a long horizontal run off the left edge of the sheet)

functions.sheet_region: top-right, PETROL VAPOUR FAN + 220V AC cutoff dotted box (0.72-0.98, 0.18-0.32)
